target_customer: Apparel and outerwear brands (first customer Ralph Lauren, Team USA 2022 Opening Ceremony)
problem: Insulation cannot adapt to temperature; Skyscrape fabric thickens in cold and thins in heat without wires or sensors.
business_model: Materials/fabric licensing and supply to apparel brands

founders.name: Brent Ridley
founders.background_notes: Named inventor on related patents (Skyscrape press release).

competitors.name: Outlast Technologies
competitors.what: Phase-change microcapsule (Thermocules) textiles from NASA-derived tech, in business since 1997

technical_complexity.rationale: Novel responsive materials requiring materials science and textile manufacturing; Ridley is an inventor on patents.

defensibility.rationale: Patents and hard manufacturing know-how; no litigation or copy found.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source of incumbents copying or buying; Ralph Lauren partnered for the 2022 Olympics ceremony.

market_need_then: Outerwear thermal comfort demand is implied but no demand data was found; Ralph Lauren adopted the fabric in 2022 (press).

branding.brand_signature: 'Intelligent Insulation' as named by Ralph Lauren for the Team USA 2022 uniforms (press)
branding.community_and_virality: Press coverage of the Ralph Lauren Team USA launch (Jan 2022)

brand_strength.rationale: Mostly B2B ingredient brand; press credits the fabric but the Skyscrape name itself is little covered.

outcome_analysis: Skyscrape is a hard-tech materials startup that took roughly five years to reach a first commercial launch, with Ralph Lauren at the 2022 Olympics opening ceremony. Verified funding and revenue are not public, so success or stall cannot be judged; slow materials development is the main pattern.
notes: YC page links a Crunchbase profile named kestrel-materials, and databases show Kestrel Materials (seed, $5.52M total incl. ARPA-E and YC per CB Insights, unverified) with Ridley as CEO; whether it is a renamed Skyscrape is not confirmed, so no rebrand or round recorded. A $120K figure appears only on an aggregator. Competitor Outlast is older than the batch and has an undated source. Name origin not found. Directory status Active. Outlast source_date 1997 is the year the source says Outlast Technologies took its name (page itself undated). Update: a Persana profile lists a 120K pre-seed from YC dated 2017-09-21, now recorded as stage other; single aggregator, and the URL could not be confirmed to be a page solely for this company.
